tip.1: Drink 8 glasses of water a day.
tip.2: Walk slowly for 10 minutes in the morning.
tip.3: Get a full night's sleep, 7–8 hours.
tip.4: Add vegetables and fruit to your meals.
tip.5: Use a little less salt and sugar.
tip.6: Get up and move a little every hour.
tip.7: Sit in the sun for 10 minutes.
tip.8: Talk with your family a little every day.
tip.9: Breathe deeply: count to 4, then let go.
tip.10: Take stairs slowly, holding the railing.
tip.12: Look at screens less before sleeping.
tip.13: Keep rooms well lit to avoid falls.
tip.14: Do something you enjoy: a book, gardening, zikr.
tip.15: Drink water along with your tea.
tip.16: Light exercise: move your hands and feet while sitting.
tip.17: Talk with friends on the phone.
tip.19: Laugh once a day; it's good for you.
tip.20: Eat on time; don't leave long gaps.
